records.claim: Paroxetine is a medication that has been used to treat depression, general anxiety disorder, social anxiety disorder, obsessive compulsive disorder, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, and panic disorder. Paroxetine belongs to the class of antidepressants known as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs). Some brand names for paroxetine are Paxil®, Aropax®, Brisdelle®, Pexeva® and Seroxat®.
